title: Smart Crafter
description: An intelligent crafting machine that searches recipes, builds full recipe trees, calculates materials, and exports crafting plans for complex modpacks.
body:
An intelligent crafting machine that searches recipes, builds full recipe trees, calculates materials, and exports crafting plans for complex modpacks.

This mod's main goal is to help people when crafting large items. So, I'll tell you how to do it. First, you'll have to craft the "Smart Crafter" machine.


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

OFF
![OFF](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3157bd3b51677cdb9e12eaf17723f4b376cc56f0.png)
ON![ON](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4a1c83aa62c723cb61858540d0c16a300f899e19.png)

</details>



Place this machine on the ground and open it. Inside the interface, there will be several options, but the one we're interested in is the search bar.

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

![PAINEL](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b3dc1fd2405a5efe591990e2b624872732a9e9d6.png)

</details>


Let's search for the name of the item we want. For example, a diamond block. I search for "diamond" and several options related to the word "diamond" appear. I select what I want, go to the "tree" option, and see how to craft that item.

Another option is to use the craft button.

What will you do? If you have the necessary items in your inventory, it will automatically perform the LAST crafting. That is, if you press the button, it will do it automatically. Then, going back to the tree, we have an option to change the recipe or remove the recipe, if you want to change or remove it.

There's also a button to download text and images. The text version is the version where we have the recipe in text form, and the image version is the image we see in the interface itself.

New improvements!

First, history, automatic settings, and favorites have been added. The settings for automatic crafting allow the machine to work independently, automatically pulling and pushing items from any machine or interface.

Note: this does not work with pipes and hoppers; that is, it is not possible to add items inside the machine, as it does not have its own inventory. Aside from that, there haven't been many other changes.

If you have any questions or want to clarify any errors, please comment here on this project.
